bounded_recommendation.summary: Build the three briefs on one shared register: a displayed surface that is supported, over a stored core that is withheld; pressure belongs in the frame, not in the promise.
bounded_recommendation.decision_guard: All directives are tradition-conditional creative direction. Nothing here selects a name, a price, a material, a vendor or a window.
next_actions: write the three briefs against D001-D016
fill every trace_slot from Assignment-1 evidence before the brief is considered done
leave the campaign window blank (ARC-13 blocked)

directive_sheets.directive: Write the core idea as a pact with a withheld interior: what the brand commits to, and what it deliberately keeps back.
Anchor the POV in the inversion on the axis: the category presses against its environment; this brand lets its environment feed the display.
directive_sheets.guard: state as direction, never as superiority

directive_sheets.directive: Audience and differentiator must be pulled from Assignment 1. The chart supplies only the register of the 'because' clause: supported display over pressed agency.
3-5 adjectives from the voice claim: exact, observant, unhurried, self-possessed, warm only where supported.
directive_sheets.guard: each adjective maps to a cited atom

directive_sheets.directive: Name choice is not chart-derived (C013 is rejected). Argue it from Assignment-1 evidence, then check it against the register in C003.
Brief a mark that behaves as a made object used in a repeated act; reference 2-3 mood-board styles and one explicit avoid-line.
directive_sheets.guard: no literal object or figure from the chart

directive_sheets.directive: Define format, variants, size and price from Assignment 1. The chart's contribution is the use-register only: value expressed over repeated use.
directive_sheets.guard: NO_CHART_SUPPORT rows must be filled from Assignment-1 research

directive_sheets.directive: Design a two-state package: a muted closed read, a warmer opened read, with the focal weight on the stored element.
directive_sheets.guard: no material or colour asserted from the chart

directive_sheets.directive: The standout element is the reserved negative space that makes the second read discoverable at three feet.
directive_sheets.guard: one sentence, describable at shelf distance

directive_sheets.directive: Connect one functional choice to the withheld-interior philosophy: the choice that slows the first read is the same choice that pays on the second.
Show pressure resolving into composure. Show the act, not the result.
One subject, low even light, focal weight on the withheld element; the frame must read without text.
Enclosed stage, one motivated light, one reserved negative space. Not an open field.
directive_sheets.guard: register only; no real location named

directive_sheets.directive: Cast hands and gesture; state explicitly that faces are avoided and why.
directive_sheets.guard: casting is a creative choice, never an inference about people

directive_sheets.directive: Order: hero (display pole, growing phases) -> 2-3 supporting -> detail -> motion; pressed-register assets close the set.
directive_sheets.guard: each block carries its phase citation; this is a preference, not a finding

directive_sheets.directive: Propose a staged hybrid path: passes with one named human approval gate at the concealed/instrument layer.
directive_sheets.guard: no budget, vendor or schedule claim

directive_sheets.directive: Do not state a campaign window. ARC-13 is BLOCKED: the case declares no window and none may be inferred.
directive_sheets.guard: silence is the correct output here
